reviewed_behavior.approval_boundary: Only the intended exact python_unittest waiting request is held. After stop, the existing validator rechecks source scope, current manifest, blocked/awaiting authorization state, no intent/receipt/result and pending R2 status; approval id/digest/revision must match the pre-stop held set. Changed or missing requests abort before compaction/restart.
reviewed_behavior.private_shutdown: The harness uses the existing --core-child private stdin control protocol, sends bootstrap secret by a framed pipe, then sends shutdown and waits for normal process exit. Forced cleanup, timeout, broken pipe, nonzero exit, already stopped or absent process do not count as confirmed graceful shutdown. The default legacy harness path remains optional and unchanged.

Post-stop boundary/approval failure aborts without replay. Final unconfirmed cleanup cannot convert a condition to success and preserves an earlier primary cause. Sidecars are not deleted or repaired to make acceptance pass.
